# hycarfilter

> hycarfilter.com — Automotive filter manufacturer & exporter from the Qinghe filter industry cluster, Hebei, China. Seven product lines (air, cabin, oil, fuel, wiper, transmission, LED) with 22 SKUs, factory capability, trilingual B2B content (English / العربية / Español), and three supporting knowledge sites (data / tech / market). Legal entity: Qinghe County Hongying Auto Parts Co., Ltd. (incorporated 2023-11-28). Contact: martin@hycarfilter.com · WhatsApp +86 13323237275.

## Site structure (English)

- [Home](https://hycarfilter.com/): Brand overview, seven category entrances, factory strengths, FAQ, inquiry CTA.
- [Products](https://hycarfilter.com/products/): Full product catalog index across seven categories.
- [Air Filter](https://hycarfilter.com/products/air-filter/): Air filter line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [Cabin Filter](https://hycarfilter.com/products/cabin-filter/): Cabin air filter line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [Oil Filter](https://hycarfilter.com/products/oil-filter/): Oil filter line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [Fuel Filter](https://hycarfilter.com/products/fuel-filter/): Fuel filter line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [Wiper Blade](https://hycarfilter.com/products/wiper-blade/): Wiper blade line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [Transmission Filter Screen](https://hycarfilter.com/products/transmission-filter-screen/): Transmission filter line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [LED Lights](https://hycarfilter.com/products/led-lights/): LED headlight line — selection guide, SKU table, procurement Q&A.
- [Applications](https://hycarfilter.com/applications/): Four application segments (passenger cars, commercial vehicles, construction machinery, agricultural machinery) with procurement points per segment.
- [Factory](https://hycarfilter.com/factory/): Production, quality control, warehousing, business license (shown separately) and certification information.
- [About](https://hycarfilter.com/about/): Company profile, brand lineage (since 2013) vs legal entity (2023-11-28), E-E-A-T disclosure, Baidu Aiqicha registry reference.
- [Blog](https://hycarfilter.com/blog/): 20 export-oriented maintenance and purchasing articles across filter topics.
- [Contact](https://hycarfilter.com/contact/): Inquiry form, email, phone, WhatsApp button.

## Supporting knowledge sites

- [Data (product database)](https://data.hycarfilter.com/): Machine-readable product database — SKU index, category pages, spec schemas, cross-reference and packing tables. Single source of truth synced with the main site's products.json.
- [Tech (technology & standards)](https://tech.hycarfilter.com/): Production processes, technical parameters, testing & QC, industry standard frameworks (ISO/SAE reference).
- [Market Insights](https://market.hycarfilter.com/): Industry overview, five regional export market reports, industry trends, purchasing guide.
